purpose: Explain calibrated odometer growth, round milestones and evidence-supported pace projections from bounded returned drive history.
primaryGoal: Set the window-start calibration, understand progress and crossings, and review upcoming thresholds with qualified forecast evidence.

dataSources.ownership: Backend historical drives; page-specific model derives cumulative progress, UTC monthly aggregates, crossings and pace scenarios.
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-scoped history key ['drives', vehicleId, 'history', boundedLimit]; enabled only with a vehicle; AbortSignal forwarded; MODERATE stale time; safeArray selection. No date bounds or pagination beyond this bounded window.
dataSources.units: Drive.distanceM is meters (web\src\types\driving.ts:9). Model divides into kilometer-valued local derived fields; display helpers convert from meters. Existing kilometer-valued calibration persistence is an explicit exception/risk, not a claim that all cache values are SI-floor compliant.
dataSources.contractVerified: Hook path and snake_case vehicle_id match the router source. Backend filtering, ordering, completeness and live response shape were not exercised.

dataSources.ownership: Existing workspace selection; URL/store/first-vehicle precedence. useVehicles request at web\src\api\hooks\useVehicles.ts:73-80.
dataSources.behavior: No competing page vehicle picker. Null selection renders the existing onboarding recovery surface.

dataSources.ownership: Existing user settings, distance preference, locale and precision. Request source web\src\api\settings.ts:24.
dataSources.behavior: Preferences alter presentation and the round-unit threshold ladder; raw drive query/cache measurements are not rewritten.

dataSources.ownership: Browser localStorage numeric calibration, with cross-tab storage event updates.
dataSources.behavior: teslasync:milestones-base-km:v1, fallback zero; shared across all vehicles; accepted finite values. Preserve saved values and document any later migration explicitly.

Clock frozen at mount; excludes invalid/future timestamps and nonfinite/zero/negative distance once; sorts eligible rows chronologically; 240-point cumulative downsampling; UTC monthly buckets; five-drive support minimum; 30-day, 90-day and full-observed scenarios; 36525-day projection horizon; five upcoming milestones.

components.chartPipeline: Category-barrel charts through ChartCard -> EmbeddedChart. Data-column alternatives, export inputs and monthly series visibility are supplied at the caller; browser execution unverified.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Four local label/value tiles repeat the three methodology accounting tiles and scenario label/value presentation. Existing KVList and stats primitives already own these presentation patterns.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing KVList where semantic details fit, or existing numeric stats contracts where measurement tiles fit; retain every value and explanatory label. No new shared renderer.

responsive.sourceBehavior: PageLayout retains w-full/min-w-0; outer pairs stack until xl; progress tiles default to two columns and become four at lg; scenarios become three at lg; accounting becomes three at sm; charts request 330px height; reached timeline is independently scrollable.

findings.detail: Fixed two-column detail tiles at the smallest allocated widths can constrain long translated labels or large formatted odometers. Source shows no min-w-0/wrap policy on each tile; clipping is a risk, not observed runtime failure.
findings.fix: Use existing Grid.minItemWidth or a one-column narrow-container strategy; retain all four details and test long strings, large values and 200% text.

sourceStrengths: Localized section names, help labels and explicit progress-ring ariaLabel.
Decorative icons use aria-hidden; scenario tables use th scope=row.
Input has label, descriptive help, numeric constraints, Enter commit and Escape revert behavior.
Charts supply ariaLabel plus named data columns; FadeIn uses the shared reduced-motion bridge.
Shared stale notice has role=status and aria-live=polite.

findings.detail: Text renders as dd inside a div-based Grid, without a dl ancestor or dt label. The four detail labels are ordinary caption text rather than definition terms.
findings.fix: Reuse existing KVList with stable row IDs and formatted values, or compose valid dl/dt/dd semantics while retaining the current four details.

findings.detail: Invalid or negative calibration silently resets the DOM value on blur; no caller error/hint announces why it was rejected.
findings.fix: Use the existing Input validation feedback with localized explanation, retaining blur/Enter commit and Escape cancellation.

unverified: effective contrast on actual composed themes

states.initial: deriveDataState.status initial drives localized section SourceContent skeletons, chart loading and OperationalBrief loading without fabricated metric values.
states.empty: Empty KPI, growth, monthly, reached and scenario bodies; progress and roadmap still explain calibration/thresholds, methodology remains available.
states.fatalError: Only source.fatalError enters sectionState.error; per-section recovery refetches the single shared history query.
states.retainedRefreshFailure: Retained rows continue into the model, StaleRefreshWarning remains adjacent, and Brief uses Retained evidence rather than replacing sections.
states.offline: Paused refresh with retained data is described by StaleRefreshWarning; no-retained paused query remains initial. Runtime behavior not exercised.
states.unknown: Unsupported pace/ETA uses missing values and explanatory copy; bounded coverage explicitly says lifetime completeness is unknown. Unset calibration still defaults to numeric zero, an existing behavior requiring careful preservation rather than silent reinterpretation.
states.noVehicle: NoVehicleSelected routes to existing onboarding guidance.

findings.detail: Input is uncontrolled via defaultValue, keyed only by distanceUnit (line 48). A cross-tab calibration change updates the model through useStoredNumber but need not update the current displayed input value.
findings.fix: Maintain a draft that synchronizes on external calibration/unit changes without overwriting active edits; preserve Escape/Enter/blur semantics and cross-tab updates.

visualIssues.detail: Roadmap caveat uses fixed bg-white/[0.025] and text-cyan-300 rather than neutral surface and semantic theme tokens. Methodology and progress also use fixed amber/cyan callout classes. Contrast failure is not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Use restrained existing surface/text/severity tokens; keep actual evidence severity, explanatory text and saved chart/theme choices. Do not introduce a new palette.

architectureIssues.detail: Calibration uses one global localStorage key despite vehicle-scoped history. Switching workspace vehicles applies the same entered base odometer to another vehicle, changing its inferred odometer and crossings.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration must define vehicle-specific calibration ownership with an explicit non-destructive migration of existing values; do not silently delete/reset the saved global calibration during presentation modernization.

architectureIssues.detail: Any finite nonnegative calibration is accepted, but buildMilestoneLadder throws when post-100000 steps exceed 10000 (model line 265). Large finite input can therefore throw during page render instead of returning field-level recovery. Conversion overflow can also leave a displayed input that was not persisted.
architectureIssues.fix: Validate converted calibration against the existing model's admissible range before persistence and provide localized field feedback; preserve model guardrails and do not weaken forecasts.

architectureIssues.detail: Existing derived model and persisted calibration are kilometer-valued, whereas wire Drive.distanceM stays in meters. This is a source-confirmed local representation exception; no backend non-SI write is present in this page.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current saved data/math in this presentation cohort; report to SI/integration owner for an explicit, tested model/persistence migration if required. Never reinterpret saved kilometers as meters.

priority.reason: Vehicle calibration ownership and finite-but-out-of-range input affect inferred measurements/recovery. Presentation already reuses the core layout and trust pipeline; fix bounded semantic/theme issues without rebuilding or removing sections.

competingImplementations.detail: The local barrel still exports a four-KPI StatStrip renderer, but the mounted page imports MilestoneBrief under the MilestoneKpis alias (page line 30). Two presentations coexist; this audit does not establish whether the alternate has other consumers.
competingImplementations.fix: Keep the mounted OperationalBrief and every metric/context. Check actual consumers before retiring or adapting the alternate; do not replace the mounted source with the dormant implementation.

dataBehavior: Preserve isolated 1000-row history query/cache key, enablement, cancellation, stale policy and returned window qualifications.

Preserve all exclusions, chronological crossings, 240-point sampling, monthly UTC context, support thresholds, frozen as-of time, sensitivity ranges and forecast horizon.
Keep all sections visible for loading/error/empty states; do not drop calibration-only progress or upcoming thresholds.
Keep retained histories through refresh failure/offline and distinguish unsupported estimates from measured zero.

Workspace vehicle is shell-owned. /milestones currently has range=false and vehicle=true under workspaceScope; no page date picker exists. Treat bounded cumulative history as the current intentional contract, not an unsupported demand to apply a new date range that changes calibration meaning.
